viewing_check: Most important: look inside the cap and on the collar for hallmarks (lion passant, anchor, date letter, JD&S) to separate sterling (A$700 range) from plate (A$50-190). Check glass for chips/cracks, leather split, whether the cup is present, and the dent in the cap. Fillers (stands, ivory/bone pieces) are low value; note ivory handle may have sale restrictions.
